TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID.description: Two letters and 32 hex digits, as Twilio documents a SID. Twilio does not rate it either way, and it is half of the basic-auth pair, so it is not treated as browser-safe here.

TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN.description: The credential. No shape is declared because Twilio documents none. Rotate by promoting a secondary token, not by editing this one.
